name: Iram
title: Chieftain in Edom
summary: Iram was one of the chieftains (tribal princes) in Esau's lineage in the land of Edom. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as the last of Edom's tribal chiefs. His role illustrates the spread and power positions of Esau's descendants in the Edom region.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Edom's chieftains
keyEvents.description: Iram is listed as one of the tribal chiefs descended from Esau in the land of Edom. He is mentioned as the last in the list of Edom's chieftains.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Iram's name is repeated in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his position among Edom's chieftains.

keyEvents.title: Esau's descendants in Edom
keyEvents.description: Iram belonged to the broader context of Esau's descendants who settled in the Se'ir mountains and established Edom's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Edom's list of chieftains
keyEvents.description: The list of Edom's tribal chiefs shows how Esau's lineage developed into an organized tribal confederation with several chieftains, including Iram.
